rules.title: Use a vetted auth solution
rules.text: Use a vetted identity provider or library instead of building authentication from scratch.

rules.title: Support MFA
rules.text: Support multi-factor authentication for privileged accounts.

rules.title: JWT discipline
rules.text: Keep JWTs short-lived, verify signature, issuer and audience, and never store sensitive data in them.

rules.title: Rotate refresh tokens
rules.text: Rotate refresh tokens and revoke them on logout and password change.

rules.title: Throttle login
rules.text: Rate limit login and password reset endpoints and avoid user enumeration in responses.

rules.title: OAuth with PKCE
rules.text: Use the authorization code flow with PKCE and validate the state parameter.
